description: Use this when the user asks to screen supported stocks by valuation, growth, profitability, dividends, size, or quality. Omit market for the existing bounded NYSE/NASDAQ screen; select an explicit exchange (LSE for London, TSX for Toronto, XETRA for Germany, etc.) or GLOBAL for supported worldwide markets. International screening requires an eligible Lite, Premium or Unlimited account. Free and signup Trial are limited to the existing US screening entitlement. Use the exact server-reported coverage or upgrade result; never fall back to U.S. results for an international request. A signed-in ValuEdge account is required and account limits apply. Percentage inputs use decimal fractions (0.15 = 15%). Supported growth controls include revenue, EPS and FCF CAGR, annual/TTM growth and forward revenue/EPS growth; leverage includes Net Debt / EBITDA. CAGR is not a requirement that every individual year grew by the same percentage. Legacy custom screens require at least USD 300 million market capitalization and a valid fair-value estimate. For independent US fundamental screening, choose screen_mode=fundamental (Lite, Premium or Unlimited); no implicit market-cap or fair-value requirement. It checks up to 1,000 indexed matches, with up to 100 (Lite or Premium) or 250 (Unlimited) eligible listings available in pages of 25 or less. If the user requests additional results, continue with only the returned next_cursor as cursor. The next page does not consume a new screen. A null total_matches means incomplete verification. For explicit international/GLOBAL markets, GBP or EUR market-cap bounds are evaluated using verified reference FX for each row's quote date. Legacy and international screens use a 60-candidate window and at most 12 returned rows, so this is not an exhaustive market scan. Fundamental mode has separate coverage and plan limits; never claim market-wide exhaustive coverage. Report applied criteria, available source dates, and missing coverage. Explain why each returned candidate matches using only visible criteria and source dates, then offer at most one optional continuation. Limited previews are valid partial research, not evidence of unreturned matches; only a confirmed plan limit warrants a plan link. This tool returns research data only and cannot place trades or modify accounts.

cursor.description: Pass only the exact next_cursor from a previous fundamental screen; no other arguments.

filters.description: Optional conjunction (AND) of 1–24 supported account controls. Legacy preset filters only tighten their stock-only, exchange, market-cap and fair-value baseline. Independent US fundamental mode has no implicit fair-value or market-cap baseline and excludes proprietary valuation and quality-score filters. Percentages are decimal fractions. Unsupported fields/operators are rejected.

sortBy.description: Server-side sort within the bounded candidate window. Does not establish an exhaustive universe ranking.

sortDir.description: Sort direction; defaults to descending when sortBy is supplied.

growth_comparison.description: For all growth minimums in a custom-filter call: gte means at least (default); gt means strictly greater. Other operators follow each field description: ratio/yield minimums are strict >, positive-multiple maximums are strict <, debt/equity and dividend-yield maximums are <=, and market-cap/score/MOS bounds are inclusive.

market.description: Omit or use US for legacy NYSE/NASDAQ. LSE=London, TSX=Toronto, XETRA=Germany, ASX=Australia, NSE/BSE=India, PAR=Paris, KSC=Korea, AMS=Amsterdam, BME=Spain, SIX=Switzerland, OSL=Oslo, STO=Stockholm, MIL=Milan. GLOBAL includes these supported markets and NYSE/NASDAQ, limited to verified coverage. Never select US in place of a requested international market.

market_cap_currency.description: Currency of explicit marketCapMin/marketCapMax amounts. USD default; GBP or EUR only with an explicit international or GLOBAL market. Do not convert pence or infer FX.

preset_id.description: Defaults to undervalued for preset-only calls, or custom when filters are supplied. Explicit presets retain their baseline conditions.

screen_mode.description: Independent US fundamental screen for Lite, Premium or Unlimited. Omit for existing presets and international screens.
